diuresis.m: Increased secretion of urine; if not due to increased liquid intake or to the action of a diuretic drug it can be a symptom of diabetes mellitus.

diuretic.m: Any substance that tends to increase the flow of urine, which causes the body to get rid of excess water.

diurnal.e: Diurnal animals are active during the day.
